nodes.description: Public token symbol string, set to 'CB'.
Public token name string, set to 'Cornbread'.
Public uint8 decimals, set to 0.
Public total token supply, mutated by minting in the fallback and burning in curse().
Public block number at deployment, used as loop seed for gas burning.
Address of the linked CursedToken contract, set exactly once via setCursedContract.
Hardcoded charity address receiving all contract ether on withdraw().
Mapping of token balances per address.
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances owner => spender => amount.
Constructor initializing birthBlock from block.number.
Internal pure safe-add helper with require(c >= a) overflow check.
Internal pure safe-sub helper with require(b <= a).
Constant function returning balances[tokenowner].
Constant function returning allowed[tokenowner][spender].
ERC20 transfer; calls external CursedToken.balanceOf and may call curse().
Sets allowance for spender from msg.sender.
ERC20 transferFrom; external CursedToken.balanceOf call and possible curse().
Sets allowance then invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender contract.
One-time setter of cursedContract; callable by anyone while it is 0x0.
Internal: zeroes a holder's balance, decrements totalSupply and calls CursedToken.issue.
Publicly callable sweep of contract ether to the hardcoded withdrawAddress.
Payable fallback doing gas-burn loop, tiered token pricing, minting and random cursing.
Caller-controlled msg.sender used as balance/allowance key throughout.
External call CursedToken(cursedContract).balanceOf(...) executed inside transfer/transferFrom/fallback.
External call CursedToken(cursedContract).issue(addressToCurse, tokencount) inside curse().
External call to ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with user-controlled spender and data.
withdrawAddress.transfer(address(this).balance) sends whole contract balance.
totalSupply += tokencount in fallback, unchecked uint arithmetic.
totalSupply -= tokencount in curse(), unchecked uint arithmetic.
balances[msg.sender] += tokencount in fallback, unchecked uint arithmetic.
keccak256(block.blockhash(block.number-1), totalSupply, seed)%100 miner-influenceable randomness.
Parameter tokenowner of balanceOf.
Parameter a of add.
Parameter b of add.
Parameter b of sub.
Parameter to of transfer.
Parameter tokencount of transfer.
Parameter spender of approve.
Parameter tokencount of approve.
Parameter from of transferFrom.
Parameter to of transferFrom.
Parameter tokencount of transferFrom.
Parameter spender (callback target) of approveAndCall.
Parameter tokencount of approveAndCall.
Parameter data of approveAndCall forwarded to the callback.
Parameter contractAddress of setCursedContract.
Parameter addressToCurse of curse.
Parameter tokenowner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Local c = a + b inside add.
Loop counter i starting at birthBlock in the fallback gas-burn loop.
Local tokencount minted in the fallback pricing loop.
Local val = msg.value consumed by the fallback pricing loop.
Local r pseudo-random value 0..99 derived from blockhash/totalSupply/seed.
Local tokencount = balances[addressToCurse] burned in curse().
Hardcoded address c of an external ERC20 checked in the fallback.
Hardcoded address b of an external ERC20 checked in the fallback.

edges.reason: Constructor writes birthBlock from block.number.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transfer debits and credits balances.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom mutates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
setCursedContract writes the trusted cursedContract pointer and is guarded only by a one-time 0x0 check, so the first caller chooses it.
curse zeroes balances[addressToCurse].
curse decrements totalSupply.
curse reads cursedContract for the issue call.
transfer reads cursedContract before the balanceOf check.
transferFrom reads cursedContract before the balanceOf check.
withdraw reads the hardcoded withdrawAddress.
fallback reads birthBlock as loop start.
fallback credits balances[msg.sender] with minted tokens.
fallback increases totalSupply.
fallback reads cursedContract for the balanceOf and curse calls.
msg.sender is the debited account in transfer.
msg.sender is both the allowance spender and credited path in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is the allowance owner and callback source in approveAndCall.
fallback mints and may curse msg.sender without any authorization.
transfer performs an external call to cursedContract.balanceOf before returning.
transferFrom performs an external call to cursedContract.balanceOf.
fallback checks CursedToken(cursedContract).balanceOf(msg.sender).
transfer conditionally invokes curse(to).
transferFrom conditionally invokes curse(to).
fallback invokes curse(msg.sender) on unlucky roll or existing cursed balance.
curse calls CursedToken(cursedContract).issue after zeroing the balance.
curse performs unchecked totalSupply -= tokencount.
approveAndCall forwards execution to an arbitrary attacker-supplied contract via receiveApproval.
withdraw is public with no authorization and forwards the whole balance to withdrawAddress.
fallback performs unchecked totalSupply += tokencount.
fallback performs unchecked balances[msg.sender] += tokencount.
fallback derives the curse decision from block.blockhash-based pseudo-randomness.
If r < percentChanceOfFailure the miner-influenceable randomness triggers curse(msg.sender).
The cursedContract address is invoked as an external contract inside transfer, allowing re-entry.
CursedToken.issue is an external call that can re-enter the token during burning.
Parameter tokenowner indexes balances in balanceOf.
Parameter a is an addend in add.
Parameter b is an addend in add.
Parameter b is the subtrahend in sub.
Parameter to receives tokens in transfer.
Parameter tokencount is the transferred amount.
Parameter spender is the allowance grantee in approve.
Parameter tokencount is the allowance amount in approve.
Parameter from is the debited owner in transferFrom.
Parameter to is the credited recipient in transferFrom.
Parameter tokencount is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
Parameter spender is both allowance grantee and callback target contract.
Parameter tokencount flows into the allowance and the callback.
Parameter data is passed untouched into receiveApproval.
Parameter contractAddress becomes the new cursedContract.
Parameter addressToCurse is the account whose balance is burned.
Parameter tokenowner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Parameter spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance.
Local c holds the result of a + b in add.
Local i drives the fallback gas-burn loop from birthBlock to block.number.
Local tokencount is the minted amount computed by the pricing loop.
Local val tracks the remaining msg.value in the pricing loop.
Local r holds the pseudo-random roll compared against percentChanceOfFailure.
Local tokencount holds the burned balance inside curse.
Local c is the hardcoded external ERC20 address checked in the fallback.
Local b is the hardcoded external ERC20 address checked in the fallback.
Local tokencount is added into totalSupply without a bounds check.
Local tokencount is added into balances[msg.sender] without a bounds check.
Local tokencount is subtracted from totalSupply without a bounds check.
Local r is computed from block.blockhash, making the randomness miner-influenceable.
